# Provenance: `tmux capture-pane -p -t zw-grounding-omp[2]` against a real
# `omp v16.1.15` TUI session (`omp --allow-home`) spawned for T001 grounding
# on 2026-07-10. Redaction: none required for these excerpts (no account
# lines captured in the tail we recorded).
#
# ==== STATE 1: idle, input-ready composer ====
# IMPORTANT FINDING: unlike the assumption baked into
# scripts/hermes/mcp_hermes_orchestrator.py:534-563 (_needs_input, "omp's
# TUI shows `❯` as the input prompt when it is waiting"), the DEFAULT
# omp v16.1.15 composer box at idle renders NO printable prompt glyph at
# all -- just an empty bordered box (confirmed both in plain `-p` capture
# and in `-p -e` escape-sequence capture: the composer line is spaces, no
# ❯ / '>' character). The live status footer bar IS a reliable ready
# signal instead: it shows a percentage-based context-usage readout.
╭──     GPT-5.5 ·  med   scratchpad   9.4%/272K 󰁨  (sub) ──────────────────────╮
╰─                                                                            ─╯
#
# ==== STATE 2: busy / working (NOT ready for send-keys) ====
# The spinner glyph + "Working…" + an "esc" hint is the busy indicator; a
# watchdog must NOT send input while this is showing.
# CRITICAL FOR THE READY GATE: note that the footer percentage
# (`10.1%/272K`, line below) is STILL PRESENT here while omp is busy -- the
# spinner does NOT replace the footer. So "footer percentage present" is
# NOT sufficient to conclude the composer is idle. A ready/injection test
# must require BOTH: (a) a `<pct>%/<window>` footer AND (b) the ABSENCE of
# any busy marker ("Working…", a braille spinner glyph, or "⟨esc⟩"). This
# STATE 2 exists specifically so a unit test can assert that the readiness
# check returns False here even though a valid percentage footer is shown.
 ⠼ Working… ⟨esc⟩

╭──     GPT-5.5 ·  med   scratchpad   10.1%/272K 󰁨  (sub) ─── Reply Pong ──╮
╰─                                                                        ─╯
#
# ==== STATE 3: interactive filter/selection overlay (needs_input) ====
# Full-screen pickers (e.g. `/model`) DO use a `>` glyph -- but as a filter
# INPUT box at the top of the picker, not as the normal composer's ready
# marker. A needs_input detector for omp must match on the picker's option
# list rendering (rows below the `>` filter line), not on `>` alone, since
# `>` also appears in the idle composer under some overlays but not the
# default one observed in STATE 1.
